features.text: UNIVERSAL FIT & LENGTH OPTIONS: Available in 8" and 10" versions to provide either standard or extended forearm coverage.
CUSTOMIZABLE SUPPORT: Features removable dorsal and palmar stays for personalized wrist stabilization and comfort.
VERSATILE CONDITION RELIEF: Ideal for carpal tunnel, tendonitis, and post-cast rehabilitation.
BREATHABLE, COMFORTABLE DESIGN: Engineered for all-day wear with adjustable lace and strap closure system.
LIGHTWEIGHT CONSTRUCTION: Offers support without restricting hand movement or mobility.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
